english.title: Deliver pursuant to a delivery arrangement a corrosive product to a person under 18 years of age
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a body corporate, who had entered into an arrangement with a seller, namely **(..SPECIFY SELLER..), in accordance with section 4(1) of the Offensive Weapons Act 2019, delivered a corrosive product, namely **(..SPECIFY CORROSIVE PRODUCT..), otherwise than into the hands of a person age 18 years or over
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(4) and (10)(a) of the Offensive Weapons Act 2019.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a body corporate
having made an arrangement to deliver a corrosive product
for a seller who, when outside of the UK, had sold that corrosive product to another person whilst not in that person's presence
being aware upon entering the arrangement that it covered the delivery of corrosive products
delivered the corrosive product into the hands of a person under the age of 18

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) 'Corrosive product' applies to the substances listed in Schedule 1 and any products which contain a substance listed in the schedule with concentration limits higher than the limits set, as defined in section 1(11).
(ii) 'Corrosive product' does not include a substance or product contained in a battery section as stated in section 1(15).
(iii) A defence is available at section 4(5) when a person takes all reasonable precautions and exercises due diligence.(iv) Please note the transitional requirement in regulation 3 of SI 2022/418 – stating this offence does not apply where the sale referred to in section 4(1)(a) of the Act takes place before 6th April 2022 and the person mentioned in section 4(1)(e) of the Act has not delivered the corrosive product by that date.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being a body corporate, who had entered into an arrangement with a seller, namely **(..SPECIFY SELLER..), in accordance with section 4(1) of the Offensive Weapons Act 2019, delivered a corrosive product, namely **(..SPECIFY CORROSIVE PRODUCT..), otherwise than into the hands of a person age 18 years or over.
